subject: Urgent: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — request for service restitution
messages:
From: Adeel Khan <adeel.khan@oxbridge.ai>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@oxbridge.ai, sana.riaz@oxbridge.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — impact to nightly scoring pipeline

Rafael / Redwood team,

We're seeing repeated high latency and intermittent 5xx spikes from your hosted endpoints that have been impacting our nightly scoring pipeline since 10/16. Our engineers observed: 
- sustained 95th percentile latency increasing from ~180ms to ~1.2s during the 02:00–04:00 UTC window on 10/17;
- a cluster of 5xx responses (~2.4% of requests) between 03:22–03:48 UTC that caused retries and backfill failures;
- downstream timeouts in our batch system resulting in missed SLAs to our customers.

I've attached the error log bundle and a short runbook our ops team put together (oxbridge_error_logs_20261017.zip). This is causing material customer impact — we need an actionable remediation plan and a commercial remedy. Per our contract (SLA section 4.2) we expect service credits for breach windows and an explanation of root cause and mitigations to prevent recurrence. 

Can we get: 
1) immediate remediation steps you will take tonight to stabilize the scoring endpoints;
2) a proposed credit calculation and timeline for issuing any credits;
3) an exec-level call with Redwood product/ops/commercial leaders to review the incident and next steps.

We'd like to schedule a call today or tomorrow morning PST. Please confirm availability.

—Adeel
CTO, Oxbridge AI
adeel.khan@oxbridge.ai

---
Attachment: oxbridge_error_logs_20261017.zip

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Adeel Khan <adeel.khan@oxbridge.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, procurement@oxbridge.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — impact to nightly scoring pipeline

Adeel — thank you for the data and the note. I sincerely apologize for the disruption this caused Oxbridge; we take incidents like this very seriously.

Immediate next steps (ops):
- Our on-call will divert traffic for your production model to a higher-provisioned variant within the same region to reduce queueing and tail latency (ETA: 30–45 minutes).
- We'll enable conservative request-level fallbacks (shorter timeouts + automatic retry with jitter) so your batch system doesn't cascade failures while we stabilize (ETA: 45–90 minutes).
- Engineering will surface a root cause summary within 24 hours and a post-incident plan within 72 hours.

Commercial: I am looping in Marcus (Sales) and Monica (Customer Success) to drive the credit calculation and the enterprise remediation work. Naomi from Legal is on copy to help with contract amendment if we need a formal addendum.

For the exec call: I'm available today 13:00–15:00 PT or tomorrow 09:00–12:00 PT. Let me know which slot works and who from Oxbridge will join.

I'll update this thread as we make progress and will include the runbook and initial analysis.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199

---
Attachment: sla-uptime-analysis-oxbridge-2026-10.pdf

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Adeel Khan <adeel.khan@oxbridge.ai>, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — impact to nightly scoring pipeline

Adeel — Marcus here. I'm sorry for the impact this produced for Oxbridge customers and for the operational churn on your side. A few quick commercial notes so we can move toward an outcome while ops finishes root cause: 
- As an immediate, good-faith gesture we propose issuing a provisional 12% service credit on the upcoming invoice covering the impacted service period.
- We'll finalize the exact credit after Ops provides fault window delineation; if our post-incident analysis shows a broader impact window we'll adjust accordingly.
- We're prepared to include a 30-day Dedicated trial (no charge) to give you a fall-back option with strict throughput/latency SLOs while we harden the hosted path.

Naomi — can you help prepare the simple amendment template (credit note + trial addendum) so we can move quickly if Oxbridge signs off?

Adeel — if you accept the provisional terms above, we'll treat the exec call as an operational review and a signature/approval checkpoint for the final credit and the trial enrollment.

Thanks — Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Adeel Khan <adeel.khan@oxbridge.ai>, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — impact to nightly scoring pipeline

Hi Adeel, Rafael — following up with the CS/ops remediation plan and a short checklist for tonight: 
- Stabilization plan (now in progress): 1) route to higher-provisioned model variant; 2) enable prefix caching for repeated batch requests; 3) apply temporary throttling on noisy routings; 4) enable KV-cache hygiene job to reduce cold cache impacts. Ops estimates full stabilization in ~4 hours from initial change window.
- Monitoring: we'll push a dedicated dashboard and alert trigger to your team (link to dashboard in Ops ticket).
- Proposed contractual/commercial steps: provisional 12% credit + 30-day Dedicated trial as Marcus suggested. Once our post-incident audit (ETA 24–72 hours) confirms the exact fault windows we'll issue a formal credit note.

Decision requested from Oxbridge: please confirm whether we can enroll you into the 30-day Dedicated trial now (this requires your team's approval to provision a VPC-connected Dedicated pool; we'll expedite network setup once you sign the trial addendum).

If you prefer, we can proceed with the exec call first and finalize the trial enrollment after.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---
Attachment references: oxbridge_error_logs_20261017.zip (logs received), sla-uptime-analysis-oxbridge-2026-10.pdf (initial readout).

Subject: Re: Persistent latency and 5xx spikes — impact to nightly scoring pipeline

Team — thanks for the quick stabilization work and for the proposed commercial remediation. Oxbridge accepts the provisional package (12% credit against the impacted invoice + 30-day Dedicated trial) subject to: 
1) a short exec review on Monday 2026-10-25 to review root cause, mitigation plan, and the credit calculation before the final credit note is issued;
2) a timeline for Dedicated provisioning (we need Dedicated up and ingesting production traffic within 7 days of sign-off); and
3) a one-page amendment we can sign that documents the provisional credit and trial enrollment terms (Naomi copied for legal coordination).

Agenda for Monday exec review (30 minutes): 
- 10 min: Ops RCA and mitigation plan;
- 10 min: Commercial summary (credit calc + trial enrollment steps);
- 5 min: Legal / next steps and signoff;
- 5 min: Q&A.

Please confirm meeting time for Monday — our preference is 10:00 PT. If you can send the amendment draft ahead of the call (redline-friendly), procurement will review prior to the meeting.

—Adeel
CTO, Oxbridge AI
